current_flow: frontend-shell-login builds the user-facing app shell (Deep Forest left nav + white top bar, branded 3F, faithful to the imported Claude Design export) and a net-new email+OTP login on top of the frontend-foundation scaffold. Input: the foundation (frontend/app router, _ds theme, next/font/local Inter, TanStack Query provider, shadcn button) + the six-route auth allow-list + the spec's normative Login screen contract + the design export. Output: routes under frontend/app/ (app)-group shell + login/, an api.ts transport (credentials, per-POST csrf re-read, refresh-once-then-retry), TanStack Query wiring, a themed shell with exactly five nav labels (only Dashboard active), and seven hermetic tests. It starts at the shell/login surface and stops before any capability feature.
new_abstractions: the app-router (app) route group shell (LeftNav + TopBar + off-canvas drawer)
the net-new two-step email/OTP login surface (login-form + secondary controls)
the api.ts auth transport (credentials + per-POST 3f_csrf re-read + refresh-once-then-retry)
the TanStack Query auth wiring (me query + otp/logout mutations + route guard)
the _ds-themed shadcn primitives the screens need beyond the foundation's button

criteria_map.the app shell (top bar + left nav) rende: KEEP. Shell faithful to the bound export, Deep Forest/Off-White from --kl-* tokens only; mobile off-canvas drawer (aria-expanded/Escape/focus). Router topology corrected to frontend/app/ (finding 1); D-0012 fixed in Tailwind + globals.css (finding 5).
criteria_map.email+OTP login works end-to-end under t: KEEP. End-to-end email/OTP via api.ts on the six-route allow-list; 127.0.0.1:4000 loopback (finding 2); an access-token 401 refreshes ONCE then retries, excluding otp/verify 401s (finding 3); TanStack Query me/otp/logout.
criteria_map.the login screen implements the spec's n: KEEP. Login implements the spec's normative Login screen contract (split screen, two-step, exact copy, input semantics, a11y); secondary controls Resend + Use-different-email specified (finding 6); functional check at 1440x900 + 390x844.
criteria_map.exactly five nav labels (Dashboard, MIS: KEEP. Exactly five nav labels, only Dashboard active; disabled items + search + freshness pill unavailable and make no feature API calls - proven by the app-shell required test (finding 4).

gaps: Router topology: the plan directed routes to frontend/src/app/(app) and /login, but the foundation's Next router is frontend/app/ with an existing app/page.tsx (conflicting roots / orphaned / page)

The prescribed runtime used http://localhost:4000 and localhost in manual verification, violating the spec's authoritative 127.0.0.1 loopback profile; manual steps also omitted warehouse-seed + WAREHOUSE_PG_*
Refresh continuity was absent: me-401 went straight to /login and the endpoint list/api test omitted POST /api/auth/refresh; otp/verify's intentional 401 was not excluded

The required tests did not falsify most accepted behaviour (refresh-once/retry/no-loop, verify redirect, logout, resend/back, mobile drawer Escape/focus, unavailable freshness pill, no-feature-API-calls)
D-0012 was only half resolved: mapping Tailwind ink to --kl-ink did not fix globals.css's color: var(--text-body), which typography overrides to a 17px size (invalid as a colour)
The login's required secondary controls (Resend code, Use a different email) had no specified state transition, API, focus or error behaviour
lucide-react was added in write scope/approach but not justified in the Decisions section (constitution §9 no silent tooling)
Proof instructions disagreed: the plan said `npm exec -- vitest` (should be --no) and used longer test names than the required-test leaf ids (decision 0009 false-green risk)
resolutions: Plan + contract corrected to the foundation's frontend/app/ router: shell in app/(app)/, login in app/login/, the placeholder app/page.tsx REPLACED (/ redirects to shell when authed else /login); non-route code stays under frontend/src/.
api.ts defaults the API base to http://127.0.0.1:4000 (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL overrides); Manual Verification uses 127.0.0.1 throughout and brings up warehouse-seed + WAREHOUSE_PG_*.

api.ts on an access-token 401 performs exactly one POST /api/auth/refresh then retries; only a failed retry clears auth and routes to /login; otp/verify 401s are excluded (no loop). refresh added to the endpoint list + the api.refresh required test.

required_tests expanded to seven, covering refresh-once-then-retry (+ no-refresh-on-otp-401), redirect-only-after-retry-fails, five-nav/only-Dashboard/disabled-items-make-no-API-calls, resend+use-different-email, and the mobile drawer aria-expanded/Escape/focus; live E2E + no-enumeration stay demonstrated evidence + the functional check.
The D-0012 fix now covers BOTH places: Tailwind ink -> var(--kl-ink) AND globals.css's color rule -> the ink token, so --text-body stays the 17px size only.

Secondary controls specified: Resend re-calls POST otp/request for the same email and re-announces the uniform ack (focus stays on the code field); Use-a-different-email returns to step 1 and refocuses the email; covered by the login-secondary required test.
lucide-react justified in Decisions (and reviewer_focus): the shadcn/ui-standard, tree-shakeable, MIT icon set - the best-fit nav icon source, host-seeded (Codex sandbox has no network).
The plan uses `npm exec --no -- vitest` everywhere and its test names EQUAL the required_tests leaf ids.

rounds.question: The single cold-read grill found 8 blocking contradictions in the frontend-shell-login plan; I resolved all of them in the contract + plan (they were spec-precision fixes, no design changes): routes on the foundation's frontend/app/ with the placeholder replaced; API base 127.0.0.1:4000 (not localhost); an access-token 401 refreshes once then retries, excluding otp/verify's 401s; seven hermetic tests covering the load-bearing behaviours; D-0012 fixed in both the Tailwind map and globals.css; Resend + Use-different-email behaviours specified; lucide-react justified as the shadcn-standard icon set; and the exact `npm exec --no -- vitest` proof command. Any remaining gap before this goes to the board for approval?
